message: Register: use the informal tu imperative (STYLE 13.2): Fai clic, Scegli, Inserisci, Verifica, Attendi, Riprova, Seleziona. Not the Lei forms (Faccia clic, Scelga), not the infinitive Fare clic, not Si prega di or Per favore.

Word on the STYLE 13.1 never list: fai clic (not clicca / cliccare), imposta / impostazioni (not settare), reimposta (not resettare), carica / scarica (not uploadare / downloadare), modifica (not editare), personalizza (not customizzare), numero di accesso (not accessione), locus tag stays in English (not etichetta di locus).

English UI or diagram word that STYLE 13.1 does not keep: Carica / Scarica, Reimposta, Impostazioni, Fai clic, traccia, corsia, legenda, preimpostazione, predefinito, tacca, nastro, filamento. Ignore a hit that is a literal name or identifier.
Feature stays feature in English (glossary Feature, STYLE 13.1); caratteristica and funzionalità mean a product capability. Keep them only for their own meaning.
Record stays record in English, invariable (glossary Record); registrazione and registro mean a recording or a log. Keep them only for their own meaning.
A DNA strand is filamento (it.wikipedia, glossary Strand), not elica, trefolo or strand.
GC skew and AT skew stay in English (glossary GC skew); skew alone is skew. Do not write inclinazione, distorsione or asimmetria.
Optional is (facoltativo), invariable masculine after the field name (STYLE 13.2); opzionale is not used.
Quotes are “…” (U+201C, U+201D), nested ‘…’, never «» or „ (STYLE 13.3).
